subject: Confirmation of Your Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], We are pleased to confirm your upcoming flight booking from New York to Los Angeles on June 15th, 2022. Your flight details are as follows: Flight number XYZ123, Departure: 10:00 AM, Arrival: 1:00 PM. Please ensure you arrive at the airport at least 2 hours prior to departure. Should you have any questions or require assistance, feel free to contact our customer service team. We look forward to welcoming you on board! Safe travels, The Airline Team
